why: A server that cannot tell which build is calling it cannot refuse a dangerously old one, cannot degrade a feature for a client that will not render it, and cannot answer 'which version broke' after the fact. These three headers are the whole handshake, and every surface that reaches the API owes all three.

clientVersion.answers: which build of that surface the user is running

apiVersion.answers: which request and response shapes that build was written against
